name: BYOC P009 R003 live mixed available/absent disclosure
command:
import os,json,subprocess,datetime
now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
s=now(); a={'ids':['WI-10000407','WI-0'],'harness':'papercusp','detail':False,'threadLimit':0,'projection':{'pick':['ok','results[].id','results[].availability','results[].ok','results[].error','results[].workItem.id','results[].workItem.state','counts','read']}}
r=subprocess.run(['node','scripts/mcp-call.mjs','work_items:get',json.dumps(a),'--client',os.environ['PAPERCUSP_SID'],'--workspace',os.environ['PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE'],'--harness','papercusp','--port','3170'],capture_output=True,text=True)
d=json.loads(r.stdout); p,n=d['results']
assert r.returncode==5 and d['ok']==False and p['availability']=='available' and p['workItem']['id']==p['id'] and p['workItem']['state'] and n['availability']=='absent' and 'workItem' not in n and d['counts']=={'ok':1,'failed':1}
print(json.dumps({'startedAt':s,'finishedAt':now(),'response':d,'clientExitCode':r.returncode}))
summary: Expected-negative live staging availability read. The replayable guard exits0 only after asserting the maintained client's exit5 and explicit mixed identity/state/availability/count result. Native orchestration also checks disclosure, source stability and containing runtime; partial two-row read only.

Actual available row retains requested identity/state.
Actual absent row is keyed, explicitly absent, and contains no invented workItem.
Maintained mcp-call exit5 is expected here: overall ok:false and successful1/failed1; never healthy.
Actual read disclosure distinguishes available1, absent1, unavailable0 and retains server timing attribution.
The three source fingerprints are unchanged across the measured read.
